g.text: POWER OFF before connecting J1/J3/J2. J3 is NOT a shorting jumper: route full load current through the external Adafruit INA228 VIN+ -> VIN- terminals.

g.desc: POWER OFF before connecting J1/J3/J2. J3 is NOT a shorting jumper: route full load current through the external Adafruit INA228 VIN+ -> VIN- terminals.

g.text: R1 uses 4-terminal WSK2512; pad 1/4 carry load, pad 2/3 are sense ONLY.

g.desc: R1 uses 4-terminal WSK2512; pad 1/4 carry load, pad 2/3 are sense ONLY.

g.text: J4 is Adafruit VBUS at the J2 load boundary + return. Leave board VBUS-to-VIN+ jumper OPEN.

g.desc: J4 is Adafruit VBUS at the J2 load boundary + return. Leave board VBUS-to-VIN+ jumper OPEN.

g.text: J5/J6 require independent reference equipment with documented paired readings; not 2 independent meters in this PCB.

g.desc: J5/J6 require independent reference equipment with documented paired readings; not 2 independent meters in this PCB.

g.text: 5V max, 0.5A nominal; current-limited isolated DC supply, proper 1A fuse, 10 ohm / 10W load external.

g.desc: 5V max, 0.5A nominal; current-limited isolated DC supply, proper 1A fuse, 10 ohm / 10W load external.

g.text: UNBUILT and NOT POWER-AUTHORIZED. No mains, solar, battery, or 24V high-power operation.
